name: Auto rip
author: Lumen Plugins
description: Copies disc after disc to MKV with your MakeMKV installation: the main feature of a film or the episodes of a series, named and filed for Jellyfin, Plex, Emby and Kodi (Movies/Title (Year)/…, Shows/Series/Season 01/Series S01E01.mkv). When a disc is done it is ejected and the next one you insert is copied. Runs only after you press Start auto rip; otherwise Lumen plays discs as usual. Contains no decryption software. Looks up title and year on Wikidata (sends the disc's name; can be switched off). Needs Lumen 1.4 or newer and MakeMKV.
